summary: George County fire tower first described by a federal survey in 1964 (windowed metal cab, about 100 ft); last described in 1971 in good condition; no source says what remains today.

facts.design: windowed metal cab with a conical roof atop a four-legged steel structure
facts.agency: Mississippi Forestry Commission (landowner, per 1971 recovery note)
facts.status_note: Last described in 1971 as in good condition; no later source says whether the tower still stands.

Mississippi State Highway Department recovery visit on September 15, 1971; condition recorded as good

corrections.why: Both survey descriptions (1964 and 1971) give about 100 feet; the 120-foot figure appears only in the Forest Lookouts site header, which is also the only source of 36.6 m.

corrections.proposed: Mississippi Forestry Commission (landowner, per 1971 recovery note)
corrections.why: The agency field held a height description; the 1971 recovery note names the Forestry Commission as the landowner, which is not the same as a managing agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts header says 120 foot steel tower (36.6 m); the 1964 and 1971 survey descriptions both say about 100 feet. The story and facts use 100 feet (30.5 m).
The 1964 description gives about 5-1/2 miles west of Lucedale; the 1971 recovery gives 4.9 miles WSW. The story gives both and uses the 1971 figure for the site description.

sources.title: NGS Data Sheet, PID BH2479 (Lucedale Central Fire Tower)

notes_for_editor: Survey sources (NGS datasheet retrieved 2026-10-21) are good on location, structure and the 1971 condition, but say nothing after 1971. The Forest Lookouts header (120 ft) is unsourced and conflicts with both survey descriptions. Lucedale Central is not marked removed on the Forest Lookouts site, unlike Luce. The brief's agency field held the height text; the 1971 note names the Forestry Commission only as landowner, so the facts keep that wording. One web search found no build date, staffing, fire or site history for this tower; its results were about the town, a fire department and antenna towers. Nothing in the record supports an access level, so none is set.
